name: Lux
title: The Lady of Luminosity

passive.name: Illumination

description.normalized: Damaging abilities afflict enemies with Illumination for 5 seconds. Illumination empowers Lux's next attack against that target, dealing 18 + Level x 7.5 (+25% AP) magic damage.

passive.rawParsedText:
Damaging abilities afflict enemies with Illumination for 5 seconds.

Illumination empowers Lux's next attack against that target, dealing 18 + Level x 7.5 (+25% AP) magic damage.

q.name: Light Binding

description.normalized: Casts out a ball of light that roots enemy champions and large monsters for 2 seconds and deals 60 / 120 / 180 / 240 (+70% AP) magic damage to them. Roots up to 2 enemies. Minions and small monsters hit by the ball of light will be dealt 90% damage, but they will not be marked by Illumination or become rooted.

q.rawParsedText:
Casts out a ball of light that roots enemy champions and large monsters for 2 seconds and deals 60 / 120 / 180 / 240 (+70% AP) magic damage to them. Roots up to 2 enemies.

Minions and small monsters hit by the ball of light will be dealt 90% damage, but they will not be marked by Illumination or become rooted.

w.name: Prismatic Barrier

description.normalized: Throws Lux's wand in a direction, shielding allied champions it passes through from 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 (+18% AP) damage for 3 seconds. After reaching its apex it returns to Lux, shielding allied champions for an additional 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+28% AP) damage.

w.rawParsedText:
Throws Lux's wand in a direction, shielding allied champions it passes through from 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 (+18% AP) damage for 3 seconds.

After reaching its apex it returns to Lux, shielding allied champions for an additional 40 / 70 / 100 / 130 (+28% AP) damage.

e.name: Lucent Singularity

description.normalized: Creates a zone of light that slows nearby enemies by 30% / 35% / 40% / 45%. After 5 seconds the zone detonates, dealing 65 / 130 / 195 / 260 (+55% AP) magic damage. Re-cast: Detonate the zone.

e.rawParsedText:
Creates a zone of light that slows nearby enemies by 30% / 35% / 40% / 45%. After 5 seconds the zone detonates, dealing 65 / 130 / 195 / 260 (+55% AP) magic damage.

Re-cast: Detonate the zone.

r.name: Final Spark

description.normalized: Fires a beam of light dealing 300 / 400 / 500 (+75% AP) magic damage to all enemies in a line. Final Spark ignites and refreshes Illumination.

r.rawParsedText:
Fires a beam of light dealing 300 / 400 / 500 (+75% AP) magic damage to all enemies in a line.

Final Spark ignites and refreshes Illumination.
